source.title: Cassadee - Azure Prodigy
source.name: Cassadee
source.description: A Mage who is skilled at dealing AoE damage and imbuing buffs to allies.

skills.name: Running Tide

description.raw: Cassadee selects a direction and invokes a 3-tile-wide wave, dealing 280% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all enemies in the path and knocking them back for 2 tiles.
active: Cassadee selects a direction and invokes a 3-tile-wide wave, dealing 280% (ATK-based) + 30% (SP-based) damage to all enemies in the path and knocking them back for 2 tiles.

skills.description_lite: Cassadee knocks back and deals damage to enemies in a straight line.

skills.name: Undercurrent

description.raw: Cassadee creates a water column beneath an enemy, knocking them into the air while dealing 240% (ATK-based) damage and stunning them for 1.5 + 0.2 (SP-based)s.
active: Cassadee creates a water column beneath an enemy, knocking them into the air while dealing 240% (ATK-based) damage and stunning them for 1.5 + 0.2 (SP-based)s.

skills.description_lite: Cassadee deals a lot of damage to an enemy.

skills.name: Tidal Strength

description.raw: Cassadee selects the nearest ally when a battle starts (prioritizing the ally behind herself), granting them the blessing of Tidal Strength. She deals extra 60% (ATK-based) magic damage to the enemy once when the blessed ally hits them with normal attacks. The blessing vanishes after this effect is triggered 9 times. Cassadee will bless this ally again after 9 - 1 (SP-based)s. This effect can't be dispelled.
active: Cassadee selects the nearest ally when a battle starts (prioritizing the ally behind herself), granting them the blessing of Tidal Strength.
She deals extra 60% (ATK-based) magic damage to the enemy once when the blessed ally hits them with normal attacks.
The blessing vanishes after this effect is triggered 9 times.
Cassadee will bless this ally again after 9 - 1 (SP-based)s.

text: Blesses the nearest ally after the previous one is defeated, with the blessing cooldown reduced to 5 - 1 (SP-based)s.

skills.description_lite: Cassadee blesses an ally and deals extra damage to the enemy hit by the blessed ally's normal attacks.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Cassadee increases her Haste by 12 during battle. She gains an extra 2 Haste when the first ally blessed by Tidal Strength is alive.
active: Cassadee increases her Haste by 12 during battle.
She gains an extra 2 Haste when the first ally blessed by Tidal Strength is alive.

text: Cassadee increases her Haste by 15 during battle.
She gains an extra 4 Haste when the first ally blessed by Tidal Strength is alive.
Cassadee increases her Haste by 18 during battle.
She gains an extra 6 Haste when the first ally blessed by Tidal Strength is alive.

skills.description_lite: Cassadee's Haste is increased during battle and even more if the first ally blessed by Tidal Strength is alive.

skills.name: Tidal Blessing

description.raw: Cassadee grants temporary blessings to all allies in the path of Running Tide, enhancing their next 6 normal attacks with the effect of Tidal Strength.
active: Cassadee grants temporary blessings to all allies in the path of Running Tide, enhancing their next 6 normal attacks with the effect of Tidal Strength.

text: Empowers the allies' next 8 normal attacks with the effect of Tidal Strength.
Casts Undercurrent on an enemy who has taken 6 hits from Tidal Strength.
Empowers the allies' next 9 normal attacks with the effect of Tidal Strength.

skills.description_lite: Cassadee grants temporary Tidal Strength blessings to all allies in the path of Running Tide.

skills.name: Enhance Force

description.raw: Cassadee reduces the Magic DEF of enemies hit by Running Tide by 20% for 10s.
active: Cassadee reduces the Magic DEF of enemies hit by Running Tide by 20% for 10s.

skills.description_lite: Cassadee reduces Magic DEF of enemies hit by Running Tide for a while.
